# Chewing dependency source review

Reviewed 2026-10-17 for the engine integration preview. This records actual source evidence and the redistribution materials the build must include; it is not a statement that merely linking an LGPL library completes all distribution obligations.

- libchewing v0.12.0: commit `05ae6bcb9309c466a1b32d69c146bc583be04747`, GNU LGPL-2.1-or-later. Full upstream source release and COPYING are retained. Official release archive SHA-256 was matched against its published checksum.
- libchewing-data: commit `c44e81aef24b06f1509f19e1be54c99812d0c43f`, the exact gitlink in this engine tag. The first four CSV header lines of word, tsi, alt and mini explicitly identify Copyright (c) 2025 libchewing Core Team and LGPL-2.1-or-later. Their pinned metadata is retained in evidence/. The data archive is generated by git archive from that immutable commit; its digest is not misrepresented as an upstream published digest.
- Only word.dat, tsi.dat and alt.dat are installed as runtime dictionaries. Upstream miscellaneous symbols.dat/swkb.dat have no separate license statement in the inspected files and are not bundled; keyboard punctuation uses our existing literal-input handling.
- All Rust packages discovered by Cargo metadata are listed in evidence/cargo-dependencies.json. Non-runtime workspace testhelper/fuzzer entries are identified as such and are not linked into the preview. Available crate LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE files are retained under licenses/. Rust standard-library attribution files must be included with corresponding source/object distribution materials.
- GuilelessBopomofo and libchewingAndroidAppModule are GPL-3.0-or-later wrapper projects; no implementation from either is copied into this repository.
- JNI glue is implemented in this project against the public C API. An APK release must accompany notices, exact source archives, Cargo.lock, build scripts, and JNI object/static-library materials permitting relinking. Do not publish a binary-only package or describe this file as granting rights to unrelated application code.
